title: Topic 6: Home & Where You Live - Vocabulary
description: Core words for home & where you live: house, room, bedroom, kitchen, bathroom, bed, table, chair. 8 tap exercises with embedded grammar.
canDoStatement: Name rooms and furniture; describe your home simply
introductionText:
house = your building  |  room = one space in a house
bedroom = room with a bed (sleep!)
kitchen = room for food  |  bathroom = room for a shower
bed = you sleep in it  |  table = you eat on it
chair = you sit on it
+ phrase bank: There is a... | There are two... |
in / on / under
+ grammar note: a + word (a bed); an + a-e-i-o-u word
(an address)

vocabularyBlocks.title: Home & Where You Live words
exampleSentences: There is a table in the kitchen.
Where is the cat?... -> Where is my phone?
My house is small but happy!

grammarBlocks.title: THERE IS / THERE ARE (G5) + prepositions IN / ON / UNDER (G6
grammarBlocks.explanation: THERE IS / THERE ARE (G5) + prepositions IN / ON / UNDER (G6) + A/AN with singular nouns (G3 intro)
patterns: there is + a + singular / there are + number +
a/an: a bedroom, a chair (an enters fully in T10
with an apple - here only noted on intro card)

questions.question: You sleep in this room. It is the ___.
Your food is in this room. It is the ___.
Tap the missing word: I am tired. Where is my ___? I need sleep!
Tap the missing word: Dinner time! The food is on the ___.
Which word is NOT a room?
A: Is your house big? B: ___
options: No, it is small. But it is very happy!
questions.correctAnswer: No, it is small. But it is very happy!

questions.question: Grammar: ___ two bedrooms in my house. ___ a table in the kitchen.
Grammar: My phone is not ON the table. It is ___ the table!

explanations.A1-T06-VOC-Q1: Bedroom = bed + room. You sleep there.
explanations.A1-T06-VOC-Q4: Food goes ON the table. You sit ON a chair.
explanations.A1-T06-VOC-Q5: A chair is furniture - it is IN a room.
explanations.A1-T06-VOC-Q6: Is your HOUSE big? -> answer about the house (it).
explanations.A1-T06-VOC-Q7: There ARE + two (plural). There IS + a (one).
explanations.A1-T06-VOC-Q8: On = on top. Under = below. In = inside.
